name: saas-next
title: SaaS glue (Next.js)
description: The glue for the saas preset on Next.js: block clients, notification actions, onboarding, the organization hook and the outbox, jobs and Stripe routes.
docs: Install the blocks first: `npx better-supabase add organizations invitations notifications search audit onboarding outbox jobs billing webhook-inbox`. The UI comes from the recipes at https://bettersupabase.com/recipes.
